components.name: Supercharger / intake manifold assembly (LT4 Eaton R1740 TVS)
components.description: The LT4 intake is a single assembly: Eaton 1.7 L R1740 TVS roots blower in a cast housing that is also the intake manifold, with two water-to-air intercooler bricks under the lid feeding 8 runner ports on the heads. Factory boost about 9.2-9.7 psi. Bolts directly to the cylinder head intake flanges with 10 TTY bolts.
components.location: Sits in the V on top of the engine between the heads; lid top about y = 0.92 m, snout/pulley at the front.

factory.name: GM LT4 supercharger assembly (Eaton R1740 TVS, 1.7 L)
factory.notes: Rotors 7.88 in long x 3.94 in dia, 160° helix; 3.1:1 drive ratio, 20,150 rpm max; boost 9.2-9.7 psi (Summit). Some sources (Whipple) call it TVS1760.

hardware.spec: M6 flange bolt, TTY (supplied in GM gasket kit 12679527)
hardware.torque: 89 in-lb (10 N·m) first pass, 89 in-lb (10 N·m) final pass
hardware.torqueSequence: Magnuson 10-bolt pattern (5 per head flange), center-out alternating sides: 1 = left/driver center, 2 = right center, 3 = left rear-center, 4 = right front-center, 5 = left front-center, 6 = right rear-center, 7 = left rearmost, 8 = right frontmost, 9 = left frontmost, 10 = right rearmost (read from Magnuson top-view diagram with pulley/front at left - verify against your manual).
hardware.notes: GM kit lists these as TTY; GM service information may specify an additional angle - verify before final assembly. Checked 2026-10: Summit SR-05493 lists 'Supercharger to Block' as 89 in-lb first pass and 89 in-lb final pass, i.e. two passes in sequence. No GM angle step was found in public sources. Remains typical.

hardware.spec: M6 x 35 mm flange bolt with seal washer
hardware.torqueSequence: Magnuson 10-bolt pattern (5 per head flange), center-out alternating sides: 1 = left/driver center, 2 = right center, 3 = left rear-center, 4 = right front-center, 5 = left front-center, 6 = right rear-center, 7 = left rearmost, 8 = right frontmost, 9 = left frontmost, 10 = right rearmost (read from Magnuson top-view diagram with pulley/front at left - verify against your manual). Gradually work up to final; pulley must still spin freely.

installNotes: Clean head flanges; install all 8 port gaskets (engine.intake-manifold.port-gaskets) and the PCV seal at the bottom of the housing (lube with Super Lube).
Lower the blower straight down with a helper; start all bolts by hand.
Torque in sequence gradually; confirm pulley spins freely afterwards.
Vacuum leak-down test the intercooler circuit before adding coolant (Magnuson).
inspection: Check SC oil level/condition per manufacturer (Eaton TVS units are sealed for life on OEM; aftermarket may differ).
Inspect coupler/isolator noise, belt alignment, bypass operation.

components.name: PCV / crankcase breather system (on-engine)
components.description: Fresh air enters the valve cover(s) from the clean side of the air inlet; blow-by is drawn through the integral oil separator and PCV orifice into the intake (on the LT4, into the bottom of the supercharger via a rubber PCV seal). Road-race cars add a baffled catch can on the PCV side and a breather can on the fresh-air side; dry-sump cars vent through the tank and may run a vacuum pump.
components.location: Valve-cover breather ports, oil separator, hoses to the supercharger/intake and to the inlet duct.

factory.name: GM Gen V PCV with integral oil separator and supercharger PCV seal (LT4)
factory.notes: LT1 uses a different PCV path into the composite manifold.

raceOptions.name: Baffled catch can (PCV side) + breather can (fresh-air side)
raceOptions.notes: Check series rules for crankcase venting to atmosphere.

hardware.spec: OEM quick connect or -10 AN fittings (race)

installNotes: Lube the supercharger PCV seal before lowering the blower.
Route hoses away from exhaust heat and secure against vibration.
inspection: Empty catch can every session and record volume - trend of blow-by.
